objective: Prefer supported choices for the actual champion, build, selected augments and offered cards; never override a reviewed incompatibility with popularity or tier.
hard_exclusion_requires: Reviewed evidence that the effect cannot trigger

unknown_policy: Unknown is not false, weak or excluded. Role labels, missing site rows, low win rate and low pick rate cannot establish mechanical exclusion.
context_policy: All compatibility facts must refer to the offered candidate and the same champion/build/selected augment/item context; a context fingerprint is required. Unmodeled interactions prevent definitive exclusion.

source_evidence.scope: Effect description only; does not establish champion incompatibility.

build_paths.selection: Predefined paths only, per champion. All are available, one active; no custom planned item selection.
build_paths.switching: Manual switch allowed during game; preserve purchased items and selected augments, invalidate prior context reviews.
build_paths.evidence_fallback: Champion-only evidence remains explicitly unconditioned on path; no missing profile is an automatic veto.
build_paths.profile_summary: Largest published sample is an illustration, never max-WR selection or a causal estimate.

offline_evaluation.ground_truth: Human judgments remain separate from the evidence used to generate a decision.
